cycles.method: Authored instructions of the sequencer-tick hook (dj_land) per tick, priced at 16 core cycles each (the conservative ColdFire V4 envelope of the earlier records); the stock routines it calls (Program Change, the kernel post, the per-track Part apply 0x40001f18, the note-off 0x40008f84) are stock cost and are excluded from both figures. Static: 41,017, an upper bound counted mechanically from patch_directjump_v7.s (the author's file unchanged) as linked: every instruction of every routine dj_land can reach counted once per iteration of each loop around it (all paths at once), loops at their caps (the arming scan 120, the 16-track loops 16, the 8-track loops 8, three event slots, Euclid's gcd 11, the MIDI Part copy 32/36/16 bytes), each call adding its callee's bound, dl_commit once (its two call sites are exclusive). Measured on the module-alone native image (MAIN OS a7074bfd...) under ot_emu --mkii (built from this checkout's sdk/octabam/tools/emu/ot_emu, SHA-256 87d73ccf...), 16 Nov 2026 (V7.3): PC watches on dj_land's entry and the hook's return 0x400a1f78, on each stock routine the unit calls and the unit's return site after it, and on the frame interrupt's entry and epilogue (its instructions removed when it preempts the tick). Scenarios: OFF; ON idle; a 16-step pattern cued at the six phases of a step; a 7-step pattern on Part 2 and a PER TRACK pattern (2x to 1/8x, MIDI tracks at 3/2x to 3/4x), both with LFO AUTO CHANGE and SILENCE TRACKS on, every MIDI LFO on a designer wave; re-jumps while all 16 tracks still wait for their first trig; and a stock pattern change with Direct Jump off followed by jumps (V7.3's restart frame). OFF 30 instructions a tick, ON idle 45; while tracks wait for their first trig up to 1,898 a tick; an ordinary landing tick 4,233, also after a stock pattern change; the boundary tick after it with SILENCE TRACKS and every track published at once 4,843 (13,195 with the stock calls); the dearest, 9,078 (17,225 with the stock calls): a cue landing on its arming tick that first publishes 16 waiting tracks (8 MIDI Part copies). Budget: the code runs in the sequencer tick interrupt (level 3, below the level-5 DSP frame interrupt, which preempts it), so its deadline is the next tick: one tick at the Octatrack's top tempo of 300 BPM is 8.33 ms, 2,200,000 cycles at 264 MHz. The MIDI START gate (dj_nofa, 98 instructions at most, the landing tick only) dj_lfoq (7, in the frame interrupt's light Part apply) and dj_swres (13, once on the tick of a stock pattern change, in stock's switch block before it calls COND_RESET) are outside dj_land. The V7.2.2 preparation (with Modwerk's six re-encodings) measured the same way: static 40,547, dearest 9,082; V7.3 as the author wrote it adds 8 instructions to a landing tick for the restart frame and saves 12 there that the re-encodings' dj_post helper cost. Not chip timing.

load.method: Emulator, not hardware: ot_emu --mkii --dsp --frame (the port above), 16 Nov 2026. Two native static-stock images: the original MAIN OS and the module-alone image, Direct Jump ON. The same 15 s on both from PLAY: one three-byte message every ms (notes on and off and CCs on channels 1-8, 1,000 a second) plus a MIDI clock byte every 10 ms (250 BPM), A02 edited in RAM to 7 steps on Part 2 with trigs on two audio tracks and one MIDI track, LFO AUTO CHANGE on, and a cue every second alternating A01 and A02. Longest frame interrupt: the most instructions between the frame handler's entry (watched at 0x4000aad4) and its epilogue 0x4000d9a6 over about 45,200 frames, priced in the port's own time (3,990 instructions a sample, so one is 362.8 / 63,840 us): 27,399 stock, 27,574 with the module (the V7.2.2 preparation measured 27,428 the same way). Idle: the port's own share, 100 x (1 - executed instructions / (3,990 x elapsed samples)). The module image is V7.3's (MAIN OS a7074bfd...); the original OS figures are the same run's as before (same image, same port). The module's tick work runs in the level-3 sequencer tick interrupt, which the frame interrupt preempts; in the frame interrupt it adds only dj_lfoq in the light Part apply.

stress.droppedExplanation: Emulator, not hardware, the run above on the module image with Direct Jump ON: 15,000 three-byte messages and 1,500 clock bytes; 15 cues gave 15 jumps, the original OS under the same input changed pattern 4 times (each cue waits for the pattern end). At 4.71 s the flood left the transport state at 2 on both images alike, and the run pressed PLAY once. Dropped: counted at the MIDI thread's handlers (note on 0x4000e018, note off 0x4000db98, CC 0x4000e79c, clock 0x40005a48): every type's entries were at least the messages sent (a few more note entries, as on the original OS), none missing. Stuck notes: no samples are loaded and nothing was sent to MIDI OUT, so audible stuck notes could not occur here. Hangs: frames advanced to the end and the transport was running. Bypass: the module's OFF state is checked in the gate (verify.py), not in this run.
